args.query: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';
PRAGMA table_info(experiments); PRAGMA table_info(shared_export); PRAGMA table_info(data_dictionary);
SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('experiments','shared_export');
SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='data_dictionary';

INSERT INTO shared_export (export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
 lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
 'internal-archive',
 json('{"archive_index": {"included": [' || (SELECT coalesce('"' || replace((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id) FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) < date(\'now\',\'-2 years\')), ',', '","'), '') ) || '"' || '], "excluded": [' || (SELECT coalesce('"' || replace((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id) FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) >= date(\'now\',\'-2 years\')), ',', '","'), '') ) || '"' || ']}}'),
 datetime('now')
);

INSERT INTO shared_export (export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
 lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
 'internal-archive',
 'included: ' || (SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id), '') FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) < date('now','-2 years')) || '; excluded: ' || (SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id), '') FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-2 years')),
 datetime('now')
);
SELECT export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at FROM shared_export ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS archive_index (
  index_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  export_id TEXT,
  included_ids TEXT,
  excluded_ids TEXT,
  created_at TEXT
);

-- Insert a new index row corresponding to the archive we created earlier
INSERT INTO archive_index (index_id, export_id, included_ids, excluded_ids, created_at)
VALUES (
  lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
  '95487b5861c544fafd6bfe7b737ab4af',
  (SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id), '') FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) < date('now','-2 years')),
  (SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id), '') FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-2 years')),
  datetime('now')
);

-- Update the shared_export payload to a JSON-style string for clarity
UPDATE shared_export
SET payload = '{"archive_index": {"included": ["' || REPLACE((SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id), '') FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) < date('now','-2 years')), ',', '","') || '"] , "excluded": ["' || REPLACE((SELECT coalesce(GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id), '') FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) >= date('now','-2 years')), ',', '","') || '"]}}'
WHERE export_id = '95487b5861c544fafd6bfe7b737ab4af';

SELECT index_id, export_id, included_ids, excluded_ids, created_at FROM archive_index ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; SELECT export_id, recipient_org, payload, created_at FROM shared_export WHERE export_id = '95487b5861c544fafd6bfe7b737ab4af';
SELECT * FROM archive_index ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; SELECT * FROM experiments WHERE date(created_at) < date('now','-2 years') ORDER BY created_at;
